title: This country saves 48% of its economy. Top 5 biggest savers 2024
description: Which country saves the biggest share of everything it earns? Number one will surprise you. Real World Bank data, counted down from five to one.
source: World Bank, gross savings (% of GDP, 2024, sovereign countries only), data.worldbank.org/indicator/NY.GNS.ICTR.ZS; population via SP.POP.TOTL

segments.text: One country saves forty-eight percent of its entire economy. In a single year. Can you guess which?

props.kicker: Saved, share of the whole economy

segments.text: Top five savers. Number five is Cambodia. Forty-one percent.
Number four is one of the poorest countries on Earth. Burundi. Also forty-one percent.
Number three is the world's factory. China. Forty-three percent.
Number two is swimming in oil. Kuwait. Forty-four percent.
And number one is Brunei. Forty-eight percent. Just four hundred sixty thousand people, sitting on oil and gas.
But Kuwait's savings ride the oil price. Sixty-seven percent in 2006. Just twenty-three in 2020.
And the very bottom is Timor-Leste. Minus twenty-one percent. It spends more than it earns.
America saves just seventeen percent. How much do you save? Follow for more money, mapped.
